cases.obligation: The macOS callback core normalizes and enqueues representative mouse input without heap allocation.
A full macOS callback queue drops the new event while preserving accepted FIFO input and bounded KPI counters.
Repeated timeout or user-input disable notifications coalesce into one worker-side re-enable request without callback-side retry.
The macOS run-loop worker drains every accepted normalized input in callback order.
macOS mouse buttons, movement, and signed scroll input map to the existing portable mouse boundary.
The CGEventTap is listen-only and subscribes only to the supported mouse-event mask, so P04b2 cannot suppress physical input.
A permission-denied or creation-failed macOS owner still publishes pass-through readiness and observes deterministic Engine stop.
